name: @sos-2/security
description: SOS 2.0 Security hardening contracts (Work Order P14): workspace isolation (cross-project workspace access is a typed ISOLATION denial, fail-closed), secrets isolation (references never values; secret-shaped values emitted into artifacts/logs are redacted or denied at the observation boundary, with the redaction itself observed), credential scoping over the P9 action-family vocabulary (a credential scoped to X cannot mint actions of family Y; broker scope escalation is a typed violation) and the policy audit trail (every allow/deny/redact/unknown decision appends a durable, replay-safe, content-addressed audit record through the P7 event discipline — never a second source of truth). Deterministic reference implementations with injectable seams; real platform sandboxing, secret stores and network policy engines attach later as adapters without contract change. Honest statuses: NOT_YET_CONNECTED for real enforcement endpoints; a policy that cannot be evaluated honestly reports UNKNOWN. Declares ZERO dependencies (lockfile byte-identity rule, the P3 precedent); the test toolchain is borrowed at run time from the frozen W17 adversarial suite (pnpm --filter @sos-2/adversarial exec tsc/vitest).
